title: Effect of substrate pretreatment on in situ heterotrophic denitrification of nitrate-contaminated groundwater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37865-37875
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05750G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dadou Salima, Djadi Amina, Yazid Hynda
An eco-friendly denitrification process using alkali-pretreated date pedicels efficiently removes high nitrate pollution (up to 218 mg L−1) from Algerian groundwater, providing a cost-effective and sustainable remediation strategy.
